pages.title: Enemy Naginata
pages.text: Naginata-type monsters. Naginata-type monsters have relatively slow attack and movement speed, use wide-area attack damage, and have average spawn frequency.

pages.name: Enemy Naginata
pages.text: The basic naginata unit of the Retrograde Army. Large in size, with slow attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Naginata
pages.text: A specialized enemy naginata with slightly increased attack power, posing a greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Naginata
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy naginata, possessing higher wide-area attack damage. A high threat.
